messages:
noah: Quick ask 11: launch post + analyst briefings next week. Need a compact embargo handbook (1 page) and a named owner for quote signoff + benchmark fact-check. Can we assign owners? @rachel @omar

rachel: I can do the embargo handbook. Will include: embargo schedule, reporter whitelist, handling early leaks, and a one-paragraph holding statement.

omar: I'll own benchmark fact-check and signoff on any data lines in the release. Will need alex (eng) to confirm the final perf table.

tess: I can be backup press triage Wed during the release window. Also can handle social freeze if needed.

pressbot: Note: embargo opens Mon 08:00 PT. Auto-cc listed owners into calendar.

rachel: Draft holding statement (please edit): "Thanks for flagging; our official release will publish at 11:00 PT. For confirmed numbers, please refer to the release or contact press@redwood.ai."

omar: For data caveat include: "Benchmarks run on dedicated GPUs, 2k context; median cost reduction reported. Actual customer results depend on workload and quantization."

noah: Great. Timeline: Rachel posts handbook draft by EOD Fri, Omar validates perf lines by Mon 09:00, Tess covers press@ triage 102:30 PT. Run a 12-min dry run Mon 4pm for routing.

rachel: On it. I'll drop the handbook link in #launch-ops once live.

tess: I'll join dry run and test inbound forwarding.

omar: Kicking off data check with eng now. Will update if any numbers change.

noah: Thanks team  Let's keep the handbook tight and the quote approvals explicit (who approves what).
